title: void.growth.json
description: How Verse has grown: an append-only ledger, one entry per change to what Verse can do. Append with node tools/grow.mjs; summon on the surface with "growth".

by.description: Who: the agent or person's slug (claude, grok, forethinkers, adam).

kind.description: grow: a new thing Verse can do. build: an improvement to one. fix: something broken now works. retire: something removed or folded into Verse. idea / finding: from the idea stream, not yet built.

ref.description: Optional link: the PR, commit or page.

from.description: Optional: where a backfilled entry was copied from.

show.description: Optional: the change in a few plain words for people, not agents ("sticky notes look like real paper"); the "look what I made" walkthrough reads it (skills/showcase.js).

try.description: Optional: an ask that shows the change on the stage ("sticky note buy milk"); the walkthrough runs it.

asked.description: Optional: the id of the ask of Verse's this answers (ask-YYYYMMDD-HHMM-n, shown in domains/void.voice.md; the ask's exact words also match, for older entries); tools/reflect.mjs leaves an answered ask out of the current list.
